title: Excessive msg.value lost when buying
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, funds lost forever  **Likelihood:** Low, requires a mistake from a user  ## Description  `msg.value` is considered incorrect only in this equation:  ``` msg.value < price + protocolFee + creatorFee ```  As a result, `msg.value` above price+fees will pass, but never return and thus lost.  It can happen in case of a mistake from users if they provide the wrong `msg.value`.
